book.title: KITABU CHA ICHANDUSO CHA MUSA KIKEMIGWA MWANDUSO

content: Ulingo wa Babeli
Haichanduso, wanhu wose muulumwengu wakala na ulonzi umwe na nongelo imwe.
Wanhu viwacholile ng'ambu ya ulawilo wa zua, wona hanhu tambalale muisi ya Shinali,
wakala hiko.
Wailongela, “Izoni tutende matofali, abaho tugoke gawe madala.” Avo wakala na matofali na lami ya kuzengela.
Abaho walonga, “Izoni tukiizengele wambo na ulingo wondauvike kuulanga, giladi tukiitendele twaga tweye wenyego, giladi sambitupwililike muisi yose.”
MNDEWA kahumuluka hasi giladi yalole idiwambo na uulingo uzengigwe na wanhu.
MNDEWA kalonga, “Wanhu wano wailumba hamoja kamba munhu imwe na kulonga ulonzi umwe, wasonga kutenda vino, avo haduhu mbuli yondawalonde kutenda yondaileke kudahika kumwao.
Izoni, tuhumuluke hasi na kuutibula ulonzi wao giladi sambiwaitegeleze wenyego kwa wenyego.”
Avo kulawa haja MNDEWA kawapwililisa muisi yose, na hewo waleka kudizenga idiwambo.
Kija kicho kilamso cha wambo dija kukemigwa Babeli,
kwavija haja MNDEWA kautibula ulonzi wa ulumwengu wose. Kulawa haja MNDEWA kawapwililisa muisi yose.
Wana wa Shemu
Wano wao wana wa Shemu. Milao mibili songela vuwishile ummemelo wa igamazi, kipigiti Shemu viyakalile na milao mia, kamulela Alufaksadi.
Na viyeshile kumulela Alufaksadi, Shemu kakala milao mia tano, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Alufaksadi viyakalile na milao malongo madatu na mitano, kamulela Shela.
Viyeshile kumulela Shela, Alufaksadi kakala milao mia nne na midatu, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Shela viyakalile na milao malongo madatu, kamulela Ebeli.
Viyeshile kumulela Ebeli, Shela kakala milao mia nne na midatu, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Ebeli viyakalile na milao malongo madatu na mine, kamulela Pelegi.
Viyeshile kumulela Pelegi, Ebeli kakala milao mia nne na malongo madatu, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Pelegi viyakalile na milao malongo madatu, kamulela Leu.
Viyeshile kumulela Leu, Pelegi kakala milao mia mbili na tisa kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Leu viyakalile na milao malongo madatu na mibili, kamulela Selugi.
Viyeshile kumulela Selugi, Leu kakala milao mia mbili na saba, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Selugi viyakalile na milao malongo madatu, kamulela Naholi.
Viyeshile kumulela Naholi, Selugi kakala milao mia mbili, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Naholi viyakalile na milao malongo mabili na tisa, kamulela Tela.
Viyeshile kumulela Tela, Naholi kakala milao mia na longo dimwe na tisa, kapata wana wayagwe wakitwanzi na wakimbigalo.
Tela viyavikize milao malongo saba, kawalela Ablam, Naholi, na Halani.
Wana wa Tela
Wano wao wana wa Tela. Tela kawalela Ablam, Naholi, na Halani. Na Halani kamulela Loti.
Halani kadanganhika kipigiti Tela tataake viyakalile yang'hali mgima, kadanganhikila muisi ya Ulu, ikalile isi ya Wakaldayo, isi yaavumbukile.
Ablam na Naholi wasola watwanzi. Mtwanzi wa Ablam kakemigwa Salai, na mtwanzi wa Naholi kakemigwa Milka. Milka kakala mndele wa Halani, ayo yakalile tata wa Milka na Isika.
Salai kakala bule sambo, avo kakala bule wana.

Tela kamsola Ablam mwanage, Loti mzukulu wake, ayo yakalile mwanage Halani, na Salai mkwe yake, mtwanzi wa mwanage Ablam, wose hamoja wahalawa muisi ya Ulu, ikalile isi ya Wakaldayo, wachola Kanaani. Ila viwavikile muisi ya Halani, wakala haja.
Tela kakala milao mia mbili na mitano, abaho kadanganhika muisi ya Halani.
